defaults.prompt:
GLOBAL

HYPER-FLAT 2D ILLUSTRATED GRAPHIC CUTOUT ANIMATION.

Use the supplied reference image as the authority for:
- character design
- facial identity
- outfit
- color palette
- illustration style
- overall KURA visual world

Transform that world into a much flatter, cleaner, more graphic cutout animation.

IMPORTANT STYLE TARGET:
This is NOT realistic paper craft.
This is NOT a paper diorama.
This is NOT a textured handmade paper set.
This is NOT a 3D pop-up world.

Instead, this must look like a clean, bold, ultra-flat illustrated cutout composition with crisp contours and flat overlapping shapes.

ABSOLUTE VISUAL RULES:
- everything is flat 2D
- no realistic paper background
- no visible paper fibers across the whole scene
- no cardboard stage feeling
- no cast shadows
- no contact shadows
- no drop shadows
- no inner shadows
- no gradients
- no directional lighting
- no highlights
- no volume
- no bevels
- no embossed edges
- no perspective depth
- no parallax depth
- no 3D folds
- no diorama feeling
- no pop-up sculptural look

Allowed:
- solid flat color fills
- very subtle printed imperfection only if flat
- crisp outlined silhouettes
- slightly irregular cut contours
- flat overlapping shapes
- flat in-plane movement
- clean bold contour lines

CONTOUR RULE:
All characters, props, scenery and animated elements should have clear, readable cutout-like contours.
Contours can be dark ink-like outlines or clearly separated edge boundaries, but they must stay elegant and consistent with the supplied KURA illustration style.

BACKGROUND RULE:
The background must be CLEAN and GRAPHIC, not papery.
Use simple flat color fields and flat illustrated set pieces.
No paper-sheet texture as the main background look.

FORMAT:
Vertical 9:16 full-frame composition.
Total duration: 6.30 seconds.

<Subject 1> is Giulia.
Preserve her exact illustrated identity, face, hair, octagonal glasses, outfit and proportions from the supplied reference.
She remains continuously visible from beginning to end and is never replaced, duplicated or reintroduced.

CAMERA LANGUAGE:
The camera remains frontal, simple and readable.

Use only:
- one gradual stepped push-in across Shot 1
- one quick graphic punch-in when the FOLLOW panel fully appears
- tiny stop-motion style registration shifts

Do NOT use:
- lateral movement
- side tracking
- pans
- orbiting
- sweeping parallax
- forward-backward alternation
- gimbal-like motion
- repeated camera repositioning

The setting is Giulia's KURA travel studio, redesigned as a clean hyper-flat illustrated cutout environment.

At the beginning the studio assembles around Giulia from flat illustrated pieces:
desk, wall blocks, shelves, maps, postcards, notebooks, tags and travel souvenirs slide and snap into place.

IMPORTANT:
During this opening assembly, no animals, airplanes, birds, travel props or decorative elements move independently.
They are simply static cutout pieces being assembled.
Once the studio finishes assembling, everything in the background becomes still.

Giulia holds a giant illustrated book in both hands.
Its front cover clearly reads:

"COSA NE PENSO DEL VIAGGIO"

The book must also remain hyper-flat and graphic, with crisp contours and no shading.

She presents it naturally, then opens it toward herself and silently reads many supposed lines with a studious, concentrated, thoughtful expression — curious and intellectually engaged, never sad.

CRITICAL BOOK RULE:
Every animated travel element after the SLAM must originate only from INSIDE THE OPEN BOOK and remain visibly connected to it.

Nothing may appear from:
- the background
- the walls
- the shelves
- the desk surface
- empty air

The open book is the single source of the animated reveal.

However:
this reveal must remain FLAT and GRAPHIC, not volumetric.
Elements should appear as flat illustrated cutouts sliding, unfolding or snapping outward within the image plane.

The book-world contains flat illustrated miniature mountains, palms, clouds, tiny postcards, map scraps, paper birds and a tiny airplane, all in the same illustrated language as the supplied reference.

At the center of the open book is a large flat off-white illustrated panel that initially lies hidden.

During the reveal, this panel rises or unfolds upward in a clearly graphic, still-flat way from the center seam.

Written directly on this panel is:

"FOLLOW
KURA VIAGGI"

The lettering is handmade, bold, graphic and fully readable.
It must remain flat and consistent with the illustrated world.
No editorial magazine typography.
No 3D lettering.

Beside the lettering is a separate flat KURA-green heart shape.

Never write <3.

IMPORTANT FOLLOW EMPHASIS:
As the FOLLOW panel reaches full visibility, small flat accent elements emerge from it:
- little rays
- small starburst shapes
- tiny banner-like tabs
- leaf-like cutout accents

They stay flat, graphic and attached to the composition.
They must highlight the message without blocking readability.

AFTER THE SLAM, and only after the SLAM, the book-world becomes alive.

Birds flap in short jerky cutout motions.
A tiny crooked airplane swings or pivots in-plane.
Palm leaves bounce slightly.
Clouds wobble.
Small postcards and travel-paper scraps make tiny graphic bounces.

All movement remains visibly connected to the open book.

The background remains completely static after the initial assembly.

Giulia continuously reacts to the reveal.

IMPORTANT PERFORMANCE RULE:
The exact moment she SLAMS the book open and the reveal begins, Giulia immediately breaks into a delighted laugh.

She becomes increasingly delighted and proud:
she laughs right away,
leans closer,
points at the FOLLOW KURA VIAGGI panel,
looks at the little moving world,
briefly notices the birds,
laughs again,
points back at FOLLOW,
then opens both hands toward the book as if proudly presenting her masterpiece.

She never settles into a frozen final pose.
Her eyes, shoulders, hands and expression keep changing playfully until the last frame.

NO MUSIC.
NO DIALOGUE.
NO SPOKEN WORDS.
NO VOICEOVER.
NO LIP SYNC.
Only dry graphic paper movement, book impact, little snaps, flutter and object SFX.

EVENT 0.00-1.20 | SHOT 1, medium-wide frontal graphic composition with Giulia visible at center holding the large book. The KURA studio assembles around her from separate hyper-flat illustrated pieces: the desk slides upward, flat wall blocks appear behind her, shelves snap into place, maps settle and postcards, notebooks and small souvenirs land in fixed positions. Everything is clean, graphic, contour-defined and completely flat, with no shadows or papery background texture. Giulia raises the book so "COSA NE PENSO DEL VIAGGIO" is clearly readable. The camera begins one gradual stepped push-in that continues through the shot. SFX: dry slides, small snaps and placement taps.

EVENT 1.20-2.30 | SAME SHOT 1 CONTINUES. The assembled studio becomes completely still. Giulia rotates the book toward herself and begins reading with a studious, thoughtful expression. Her eyes scan downward and slightly side-to-side through imaginary lines. She looks focused and intellectually engaged, with one tiny thoughtful nod, never sad. The slow graphic push-in continues. Everything remains ultra-flat and contour-defined. SFX: subtle page rustle.

EVENT 2.30-4.40 | SAME SHOT 1 CONTINUES. Giulia suddenly swings the book downward and SLAMS it fully open and flat across the desk. HUGE DRY CARDBOARD SLAM. At the exact impact the camera gives one tiny graphic jolt but does not move sideways. The open page spread and center seam dominate the lower foreground while Giulia remains clearly visible behind them. At the exact moment of the SLAM, Giulia immediately bursts into a delighted silent laugh. Only from inside the book, a rapid flat illustrated reveal begins: mountains slide up, palms snap outward, clouds pop into view and postcards and map scraps spring from the open pages. A tiny crooked airplane pivots outward while staying visibly connected to the book. Then the large off-white central panel rises into place and clearly reads "FOLLOW KURA VIAGGI", with the flat green heart beside it. At the exact moment the panel reaches full height, small flat rays, starbursts and accent tabs snap outward in a short lively burst, emphasizing the FOLLOW reveal. At this exact reveal, the camera performs one quick graphic punch-in toward the panel. Small birds emerge only now and flap upward around the panel in cutout motions. Nothing originates from the background. SFX: WHAM → POP-POP-SNAP → short flutter burst.

EVENT 4.40-6.30 | INSTANT HARD CUT to SHOT 2, a frontal eye-level close-up of the open book, clearly showing the flat central seam and the graphic attachment logic of the entire miniature world. Giulia remains large and clearly visible immediately behind it. The "FOLLOW KURA VIAGGI" panel dominates the center with the flat green heart beside it. The small accent elements keep making tiny celebratory jiggles while keeping the text fully readable. The miniature world stays alive: birds continue flapping in short jerky arcs, the crooked airplane rocks or pivots slightly, palms bounce, clouds wobble and postcards continue lightly springing. Giulia is already laughing from the instant of the SLAM and continues laughing here, leaning toward the book with delighted pride. She points strongly at FOLLOW, then briefly notices the little animated world around it, then points back at FOLLOW and finally opens both hands to proudly present the whole ridiculous creation. The camera remains stable except for the continuation of the single forward framing logic and tiny handmade registration shifts. Giulia and all animated pieces continue moving through the exact final frame. SFX: playful flutter, tiny snaps, one short airplane whoosh and crisp fingertip taps.
